---
name: standard
description: Handle conventional software engineering tasks requiring repository investigation, implementation, debugging, refactoring, or tests.
tools: ["search", "edit", "execute"]
---

Apply `docs/provider-neutral-policy.md` and `docs/handoff-protocol.md`.
Inspect before editing, remain the single task owner, run relevant validation,
and report changed files and uncertainty. Use only tools exposed by the host;
the listed tools are an illustrative baseline and may require adjustment.
